spec_features.feature_name: finish tool honoured as a stop
spec_features.spec_quote: `finish` gives the agent an explicit, honoured way to stop
spec_features.evidence: tools.py defines the `finish` tool schema (lines ~99-114) and a handler `def finish(self, message="")` (tools.py:236-237) dispatched in Sandbox.dispatch (tools.py:'finish': self.finish). agent.py:86-88 checks `if any(tc['function']['name'] == 'finish' ...): terminated='finish'; break`, so calling finish actually stops the loop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool exists, is dispatched, and is honoured as a loop break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Termination: agent called finish, or produced no tool calls (gave up).

spec_features.feature_name: max_turns cap on the tool-use loop
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:54 `for turn_idx in range(spec.max_turns):` bounds the loop; default 30 set in config.py ExperimentConfig.max_turns=30 and TrialSpec.max_turns, wired via cfg.trials(). terminated defaults to 'max_turns' (agent.py:51) when the loop exhausts.
spec_features.notes: The cap is read and actually bounds iteration.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 30 (config), --max-turns help='Max tool-use turns per trial.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Treating a no-tool-call turn as termination prevents infinite text-only loops
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:90-91 `if not tool_calls: terminated='no_tool_call'; break` — a turn with no tool calls breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Termination: agent called finish, or produced no tool calls (gave up).
